# Release v3.5.0

<!-- Generated by cidx on 2026-09-29 16:45 -->
<!-- Edit this file to customize your release notes -->

## ✨ Features

- **generate:** opt-in per-phase cache for the workspace paths a phase rebuilds (#506)

  A phase can declare what to keep between CI runs and which files decide when
  that is stale:

  ```toml
  [build]
  containers = ["cargo-build"]
  cache = ["target"]
  cache_key = ["**/Cargo.lock"]
  ```

  The generated job gets an `actions/cache` step keyed on the runner OS, the
  phase and the hash of those files, falling back to the previous cache of that
  phase. A Rust build no longer compiles every dependency from scratch on every
  job (about 21 minutes cold against 6 warm) (#503). `cache_key` is required,
  and a declaration that leaves the workspace or cannot be written safely into
  the YAML is refused by both `cidx validate` and `cidx generate`.

- **generate:** cancel a pull request's superseded runs (#505)

  The generated workflow cancels an older run of the same pull request when a
  newer push arrives. A run that is not a pull request — a push to main, a tag —
  gets a group of its own and is never cancelled (#504). Regenerate your
  workflow to pick it up.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **release:** count only `chore/release-v<version>` branches as a release in flight (#499)

  An ordinary `chore(release): …` pull request no longer makes
  `cidx release create` refuse to start (#498).

## 🔧 Maintenance

- **release:** pin the commitizen action image by digest and drop the dead
  `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` line from `cidx.toml` and the complete example (#497)
- **renovate:** widen the schedule to the whole of Monday (#500)
